title: Finite quotient diagrams and consecutive Cech labels
statement: For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] and a profinite group $G$, in compatible small universes [def-weil-size-convention], define $\mathrm{labelPower}_q(A)=A^{\{0,\ldots,q-1\}}$ on sets and by postcomposition on maps. The finite label diagram sends every open normal subgroup $N$ to $\coprod_{a\in(G/N)^q}T$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], and sends $M\subseteq N$ by the quotient label map and the identity on $T$. For any group $K$ and $g:\{0,\ldots,q-1\}\to K$, put $p_i(g)=\prod_{j<i}g_j$, in increasing order (the list prefix product, also defined for all natural $i$). For an order-preserving simplex map $\varphi:[n]\to[m]$, define the restricted consecutive labels of $g\in K^m$ by $g^{\varphi}_i=p_{\varphi(i)}(g)^{-1}p_{\varphi(i+1)}(g)$ for $0\le i<n$.
